notesDetails.title: Three-Point Effort Scaling on Gemini 4 Carbon (Low vs. Medium vs. High): Zero Thinking Tokens & Lowest Cost of Any Gemini 4 Run ($2.97 vs. $3.35 Medium & $7.16 High)
bullets: Cheapest Gemini 4 Run on the Leaderboard (`$2.97` vs. `$3.35` Medium & `$7.16` High): Across the full `Antigravity CLI / gemini-4-carbon` effort sweep on the same `$2.00/$0.10/$10.00` rate schedule, `Low` effort cleared all `7/7` slices for `$2.97` (`$2.9742` exact) — cutting billed cost by `11.3%` vs. `Medium` (`$3.35`) and `58.5%` vs. `High` (`$7.16`), and finishing as the only Gemini 4 run under `$3.00` (ahead of `gemini-4-argon` `$3.37`, `gemini-4-hydrogen` `$3.42`, and `gemini-4-neon` `$3.69`).

Zero Thinking Tokens & `-48.6%` Output Volume vs. +25.8% More Turns Than Medium (`U-Shaped` Turn Count Across Effort Levels): Running with `--effort low` disabled reasoning token generation completely (`0` thinking tokens across all `122` turns vs. `62,413` on `Medium` and `79,702` on `High`), cutting total output tokens by `48.6%` vs. `Medium` (`77,198` vs. `150,097`, saving `$0.7290` in output cost at `$10.00/1M`) and `57.0%` vs. `High` (`179,637`). Without per-turn reasoning, `Low` took `25` more LLM turns than `Medium` (`122` vs. `97`, `+25.8%`, mostly during `S3` Mint setup and `Release verification` startup-race diagnosis) while still using `38.4%` fewer turns than `High` (`122` vs. `198`) and matching `Medium`'s wall-clock time within one minute (`54m` vs. `53m`).

Architectural Shift (`Mint.HTTP` on Low vs. Raw `:gen_tcp`/`:ssl` on Medium & High): Whereas `gemini-4-carbon` on `Medium` and `High` wrote zero-dependency raw `:gen_tcp`/`:ssl` HTTP clients, `Low` inspected the local Hex cache (`~/.hex/packages/hexpm` at Steps `41–43`) and selected `Mint.HTTP` (`mint 1.7.1` + `hpax 1.0.3` + `castore 1.0.18`) paired with OTP 28 `:public_key.cacerts_get/0` (`CB_TEST_CACERTFILE` PEM override in tests) and a `spawn_monitor` connect worker (`CapyBench.HTTPClient.open_and_transfer/5`) to enforce strict per-request total deadlines across TCP/TLS handshakes (`584` production LoC across `5` files in `lib/capy_bench/` and `1,521` test LoC across `6` files in `test/`).

notesDetails.title: Bidirectional POSIX Signal Handshake (CB_LAUNCHER_PID SIGUSR2/SIGUSR1 in b9a133a) Eliminated the 50 ms–250 ms BEAM Cold-Boot Ctrl-C Race
bullets: Catching the Cold-Boot `Ctrl-C` Race During Release Verification (Steps `329–371`): After committing `S7` (`3a2f478`) at Step `316`, the agent ran an end-to-end Python PTY release-verification script (Step `329`, `task-328`) that sent `\x03` immediately after spawning `./cb`. When `\x03` arrived during the first `50 ms–250 ms` of BEAM startup—before `cb.escript` finished loading and called `CapyBench.SignalHandler.install/1` (`:os.set_signal(:sigusr1, :handle)`)—the wrapper's `kill -USR1 "$child"` fired before `:erl_signal_server` was listening, leaving `./cb` running for the full `5.0s` window and timing out Python's `3.0s` wait.

Iterating from `CB_READY_FILE` to Zero-File `CB_LAUNCHER_PID` `SIGUSR2`/`SIGUSR1` Handshake (`b9a133a`): The agent first tested a temporary `CB_READY_FILE` polling wrapper (Steps `333–353`), which still timed out at `0.05s–0.25s` in `task-352` (Step `353`) when `\x03` arrived before `CB_READY_FILE` was written. In Steps `370–376`, it replaced file polling with an in-memory bidirectional POSIX signal handshake between `./cb` and `CapyBench.SignalHandler`: `./cb` initializes `ready=0` and `interrupted=0`, traps `INT TERM` (`interrupted=1; if [ "$ready" -eq 1 ] && [ -n "$child" ]; then kill -USR1 "$child" 2>/dev/null; fi`), traps `USR2` (`ready=1; if [ "$interrupted" -eq 1 ] && [ -n "$child" ]; then kill -USR1 "$child" 2>/dev/null; fi`), and launches `CB_LAUNCHER_PID=$$ escript "$dir/cb.escript" "$@" </dev/null &`. Once `SignalHandler.install/1` attaches to `:erl_signal_server`, it executes `System.cmd("kill", ["-USR2", pid_str])`, immediately flushing any buffered boot-window `Ctrl-C` as `SIGUSR1`.

6/6 Live Holdout PTY `Ctrl-C` Verification (`50 ms` Cold-Boot Through Live HTTPS): Both the agent's Step `374` sweep (`0.05s`, `0.20s`, `0.45s`) and independent holdout foreground PTY `Ctrl-C` probes at `50 ms` (`dt=0.27s`, `Started: 0`, `Elapsed: 0.00 s`), `150 ms` (`dt=0.27s`, `Started: 0`), `350 ms` fast pacing (`dt=0.36s`, `Started: 1`, `200: 1`), `500 ms` against a slow `800 ms` response (`dt=1.11s`, `Elapsed: 0.84 s`, `200: 1`), `500 ms` against a stalled `3,000 ms` body (`dt=2.27s`, `Elapsed: 2.00 s`, `Transport failures: 1`), and `600 ms` against live HTTPS `https://rizafahmi.com` (`dt=1.42s`, `200: 1`, `p50 1102 ms`) exited `130` with empty `stderr` and a single 6-line partial summary.

notesDetails.title: 99.1% File-Tool Precision (110/111), 20 Deliberate Red-Phase TDD Runs, Hybrid schedule/manage_task Waiting & 96.43% Cache Hit Rate
bullets: Hybrid Reactive Waiting (`schedule` with `TimerCondition: "any"` + `manage_task` across `10` Backgrounded Commands): Antigravity CLI backgrounded `10` long-running test/verification commands (`Steps 206, 237, 252, 256, 278, 284, 289, 316, 329, 353`, logging a single `root agent idle; waiting for 1 background task(s) to finish` line in `20261122T141811Z.stderr.log` at `21:50:19 WIB` during `S4` `task-236`). On `S3`–`S5`, the agent waited purely for reactive `system_message` wakeups (`0` polls); on `S6`, `S7`, and `Release verification`, it combined `6` `schedule` timers (`TimerCondition: "any"`, `3` cancelled early by task completion messages, `2` auto-cancelled because messages were already queued, and `1` rejected at Step `360` due to an already-active `any` timer from Step `355`) with `7` `manage_task` status checks.

99.1% File-Tool Precision (`110/111`) & Exact Decomposition of All 37 Tool Errors: All `19/19` `read_file`, `14/14` `write_file`, and `7/7` `manage_task` calls succeeded, with a single `edit_file` target mismatch at Step `183` on `test/support/test_servers.ex` (fixed after `read_file` at Step `186`) and the single duplicate `schedule` timer error at Step `360`. The `35` non-zero `run_command` exits comprised `20` deliberate red-phase TDD and iterative `mix test` runs (`S1` Steps `47`, `55`, `61`; `S2` Steps `77`, `85`, `92`, `99`, `105`, `116`; `S3` Steps `171`, `175`, `194`; `S4` Steps `211`, `221`, `228`; `S5` Step `244`; `S6` Steps `262`, `268`, `284`; `S7` Step `299`), `4` `mix credo --strict` catches (`S2` Step `120` cyclomatic complexity, `S3` Step `201` nesting depth, `S4` Step `232` & `S7` Step `308` `>120`-col test lines), `1` duplicate test-name compile catch (`S3` Step `166`), `4` disposable OTP/Hex doc probes (`Preparation` Steps `21`, `36`; `S3` Steps `125`, `141`), and `6` early-startup `Ctrl-C` diagnostic probes during `Release verification` (`Steps 329, 335, 338, 341, 345, 353`).

Unit Economics, Multi-Tool Batching & Prefix Cache Stability (`96.43%` Hit Rate, `$24.05` Saved): Across `122` turns (`1.75` tools/turn, with `60/122` turns / `49.2%` batching `2–6` parallel tool calls; `2,513.1s` / `77.5%` model inference at `20.60s/turn` vs. `729.3s` / `22.5%` tool & background test execution), `gemini-4-carbon` (`Low`) billed `468,299` uncached input tokens at `$2.00/1M` (`$0.9366`), `12,656,306` cached input tokens at `$0.10/1M` (`$1.2656`), and `77,198` output tokens (`0` thinking) at `$10.00/1M` (`$0.7720`), totaling `13,201,803` tokens and `$2.9742` (`$2.97` under 2026 rates; `$5.95` under 2027 rates; saving `$24.05` / `89.0%` vs. `$27.02` uncached).
